title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Hague-Visby limit on a settlement
content:
## Scope

This rule of the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line computes the Hague-Visby limit that applies when a claim is approved under the Hague-Visby limitation measure, and fixes which limitation the approval records when that limit binds.

## Rule

1. The Hague-Visby limit is the higher of two figures: the per-package limit multiplied by the affected packages, and the per-kilogram limit multiplied by the affected weight in kilograms.
2. That higher figure is converted into US dollars at the SDR conversion rate of the claims tariff and rounded to the cent.
3. When the Hague-Visby limit bound the settlement, the approval records the per-package limitation or the per-kilogram limitation, naming whichever of the two limits was the higher.

## Hypothetical worked examples

The tariff figures below are hypothetical and chosen only to show the working: 500 SDR per package, 3 SDR per kilogram, 1.2 USD per SDR.

| Affected packages | Affected weight | Per-package figure | Per-kilogram figure | Higher figure | Limit in USD | Limitation recorded if it binds |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | 1,000 kg | 4,000 SDR | 3,000 SDR | 4,000 SDR | 4,800.00 | Per-package |
| 2 | 2,500 kg | 1,000 SDR | 7,500 SDR | 7,500 SDR | 9,000.00 | Per-kilogram |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

- *Wrong reading:* the lower of the two figures applies. *Correct basis:* the higher of the two figures is the limit.
- *Wrong reading:* the two figures are added together. *Correct basis:* only the higher one is taken, then converted and rounded.
